movelist.name: Bind
movelist.effect: The user gains a +1 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers, and +2 to Skill Checks made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers or gain Dominance. Whenever the user gains Dominance in a Grapple, the target of the Grapple loses a Tick of Hit Points.

movelist.name: Feint
movelist.effect: If a foe uses a Move with the Shield Keyword in response to one of your actions, you may activate Feint to cause the triggering Move to Fail. Feint is activated as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Rock Smash
movelist.effect: Rock Smash lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.effect: The user cannot be Flinched, and their Initiative cannot be unwillingly lowered by any effects.
